description.zh: 按一下快捷键，当前窗口就一直显示在其他窗口上面，再按一下取消；也可以在搜索框里输入“置顶”挑一个窗口。管理员身份运行的窗口改不了
description.en: One shortcut keeps the window in front above the others, and takes it off again; or type “top” in the search box and pick a window. Not for windows run as administrator

notes.zh: 新插件：Win+Ctrl+T 把当前窗口放在所有窗口最前，再按一次取消（快捷键可改，由 Win顺 注册）；输入“置顶”或 top 列出打开的窗口，已置顶的在前，Enter 切换。窗口顶部会短暂显示结果，做不到时（管理员窗口、没有响应、已关闭）说明原因。插件停止时取消它置顶过的窗口。
notes.en: New plugin: Win+Ctrl+T keeps the current window above all others and a second press takes it off (the key can be changed and is registered by WinShun); 置顶 or top lists the open windows, those on top first, Enter switches one. A note at the window's top says what happened, or why it could not (an administrator's window, not responding, closed). Windows it put on top come off when the plugin stops.
